{{Quote|Captain Shard of the MedStar frigate ''Golandras'' and an elite unit fresh from Kamino will rendezvous with you at the Marat system's edge—[garbled]—a "mercy mission."|Mace Windu|<ref name="Skyewalkers" />}}
The '''''Golandras''''' was a [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brisha Shard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was destroyed shortly before the [[Battle of Skye]]<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched that [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] to the [[Marat system/Legends|Marat system]]. The ''Golandras'' fell into an orbital ambush set by the terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]], who had installed a minefield cloaked with [[Nagai/Legends|N'Gai]] technology in the vicinity of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]].<ref name="Skyewalkers" />
